tags.name: Lighthouse Reef
tags.description: Sheltered muck and macro diving site in a bay on the northern side of Sangeang Island (Lighthouse Bay / Tanjung Menjangan). Black volcanic sand with coral reef to the west and east and scattered bommies, reaching about 29m. Reported critters include pygmy seahorses, ornate ghost pipefish, nudibranchs, frogfish, boxer crabs and flame file shells.
